producer: S2 bounded one-time slice-builder legacy migration

judgments.subject: structure.sections.identity
judgments.conclusion: This section identifies the retained slice-builder role and its complete-slice responsibility; the experimental record does not replace the legacy skill as owner.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.launch-builder
judgments.conclusion: This section describes launch configuration, evidence affordances, and provider boundaries that apply before and during builder execution; it is preserved without selective omission.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.builder-lifetime
judgments.conclusion: This section owns builder and reviewer continuity consequences whose causal parents are retained context value, review-episode identity, and truthful recovery provenance.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.planning-turn
judgments.conclusion: This section applies to the read-only planning phase and produces the plan and placement certificate without granting mutation authority.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.implementation-turn
judgments.conclusion: This section applies only after mediated plan acceptance and constrains mutation to the accepted task boundary.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.gate-turn
judgments.conclusion: This section assigns deterministic gate execution to the builder and specialist selection to the supervisor while preserving specialist finding ownership.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.reasoning-escalation
judgments.conclusion: This section defines evidence-conditioned reasoning escalation and does not grant a general authority to replace builders or alter configuration.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.scope-enforcement
judgments.conclusion: This section preserves the prohibition on silent scope expansion and mutation of unattributed work.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.final-receipt
judgments.conclusion: This section owns the builder-produced receipt and proposal consequences while durable acceptance and publication remain mediated by their existing owners.
